description: Get a link so Bettrails notifies the user before a match starts. Kinds: esoccer_duel (league + player1 + player2: about 10 minutes before each of their next duels, with their head-to-head), basket_duel (league nba|euro|ggl + player1 + player2), esports_team (game lol|dota|cs2|valorant + team: 1 hour before each match and the result). The link opens Bettrails, where the person confirms with a free account (created in the same step if needed). Bettrails sends the notifications itself.

language.description: Language of the bettrails.com links returned (normally the language of the conversation). Default: es.

league.description: esoccer_duel: eSoccer league key (gt, adriatic, valhalla, valkyrie, ggleague, esportsbattle, erivals, cyberlivearena, volta); basket_duel: nba, euro or ggl.

team.description: esports_team only: team name, e.g. "T1" or "Team Vitality".

name: alert_link
title: Bettrails alert
